In the morning you head down for breakfast before starting the day. i Boutique Hotel is a 3-star boutique hotel in Map Yang Phon, Pluak Daeng District, near the Amata City Rayong industrial estate and the Eastern Seaboard industrial zone · what a lot of people point to is rooms that are more spacious and cleaner than the price suggests, a quiet setting, easy parking, and breakfast that gets praise · there are around 84-94 rooms, from Standard Double up to Deluxe at around 37 sqm, starting from about THB 860/night, scored around 8.1 from 86 reviews on Trip.com.

body.html: Overview and who it suits — if you want the shortest possible summary, i Boutique Hotel is a hotel for people who want a spacious, clean, quiet room that's good value, in a location close to the Amata City Rayong industrial estate, rather than a beachfront resort or a place in the middle of a tourist district · it's a 3-star boutique hotel located in Map Yang Phon Subdistrict, Pluak Daeng District, Rayong Province, in the borderland of the Eastern Seaboard industrial zone that connects Chonburi and Rayong, one of the hubs for factories and offices of many multinational companies, especially Japanese and European firms · it's been open since 2016 with around 84-94 rooms and a concept that handles both short and longer stays · real reviews agree that the people it suits best are those coming to work or do business at the Amata estate and the Pluak Daeng-Rayong industrial area — company staff, engineers, clients visiting for site inspections or factory audits, and people stationed here long term · another group that says they were impressed is families who want a spacious room, a quiet setting, and easy parking, along with people driving the Rayong-Pluak Daeng route who need a clean, affordable place to stop for the night · on the flip side, people who are mainly here to enjoy the beaches at Pattaya or Ban Phe in Rayong may feel this location is fairly far from the coast and the tourist districts, and should consider staying on the Pattaya side or in downtown Rayong instead · simply put, i Boutique plays on "good value, quiet, and practical" in a location built around the convenience of estate workers, rather than selling sea views or a holiday atmosphere — and that's why it earns solid review scores from guests who already know what they came for.

Location and getting around — i Boutique Hotel is in Map Yang Phon Subdistrict, Pluak Daeng District, Rayong Province, in an area that sits on the border of the Eastern Seaboard industrial zone between Chonburi and Rayong · the biggest strength of this location is how close it is to the Amata City Rayong industrial estate (Amata City), a major estate in the eastern region with many factories and offices of multinational companies, especially in automotive, electronics, and parts · for people coming to work or attend meetings at the estate, staying here means you can drive to work in a short time, without having to ride in from Pattaya or downtown Rayong every morning · the Map Yang Phon area around the hotel also has local eateries and convenience stores to rely on day to day, even though it isn't a department-store or walking-street district · a bit further out, CK Stadium is around 3 kilometers away, Pattaya Beach is around 44-45 kilometers, and Jomtien Beach around 51 kilometers · importantly, it's around 37 kilometers from U-Tapao Airport (UTP) and around 95 kilometers from Suvarnabhumi Airport, so people who fly in and then drive on to the estate can stay here conveniently · the honest observation is that a location like this isn't designed for people without a car — the area around the hotel is an estate zone and community-edge roads, not a stroll-friendly district lined with cafes and restaurants within walking distance. If you don't have your own car, plan to use a ride-hailing app or ask the hotel about transport in advance, and plan your meals outside the hotel carefully.

"I came to work at the Amata estate for several days and chose this place because it's only a few minutes' drive to the factory. The room was more spacious than I expected, with a balcony to sit and catch the breeze in the evening. It's nice and quiet, so I slept well, and parking was easy too. Next time I come, I'll stay here again."

Room types and decor — i Boutique Hotel has around 84-94 rooms across several tiers to handle both one-night guests and longer stays · it starts with the Standard Double, a standard room with a large bed, stepping up to Deluxe King and Deluxe Twin at around 37 sqm that are more spacious than the standard rooms at many hotels in the same class, with two single beds for people traveling for work as a pair or with a colleague, and larger rooms like Grand Deluxe and suites for families or anyone wanting more usable space · the point real reviews agree on most is that the rooms are more spacious than the price and clean — even the entry-level room gives you comfortable usable space, and nearly every room has a balcony to step out for some air or sit and relax in the evening · the decor is a tidy boutique style, warm tones, easy to live with, function over flash · in-room amenities cover everything you need for a stay: flat-screen TV, air conditioning, fridge, tea and coffee maker, work desk, and Wi-Fi · many reviews praise the cleanliness of the rooms and comfortable beds, along with bathrooms that are easy to use and good hot-water flow · the honest thing to know is that since the building has been open since 2016, some reviews say certain details are starting to show their age and some corners feel a bit dim, so anyone expecting brand-new, luxurious decor like a tourist hotel may need to adjust their expectations — but in terms of space, cleanliness, and real usability, it does well at this price.

Facilities and gym — even though it's a mid-size boutique hotel aimed at working guests, i Boutique Hotel still has enough facilities to unwind comfortably after work · there's a gym with exercise equipment for people who want to keep up their workout routine while traveling, plus a billiard room, garden, and terrace to sit and relax for a change of scene · parking is a big advantage for people driving themselves, because there's free parking on the hotel grounds, which matters for a location like this where nearly everyone travels by car, and many reviews mention that parking is easy without having to compete for a spot · there's also a meeting room for corporate clients running activities or training at the estate, a luggage-storage service, and a front desk that helps coordinate things in the area · to be straight about it, this hotel doesn't have a swimming pool, which is worth knowing before you book if you're a family wanting the kids to swim or someone planning a resort-style break · as for Wi-Fi, it's free in the common areas, but some reviews and booking details note that in-room use may come with conditions or an extra charge on certain packages, so people who need to take online meetings or do work that's heavy on data should check clearly and keep a backup mobile SIM on hand.

Food and dining — the restaurant at i Boutique Hotel mainly serves Thai food, and the point many reviews praise is that the food is inexpensive but tasty, both at dinner and for breakfast · for people coming to work at the estate who don't want to drive out to far-off places in an area where eateries aren't as dense as in the city, having an in-house restaurant with friendly prices is an advantage that fits this group of guests well · breakfast gets praise for being filling and good value, and many reviews say it's the thing that helps you start the workday comfortably without going out · for other meals, since the location is in Map Yang Phon, there are local eateries and made-to-order shops to choose from within a short drive of the hotel; anyone wanting a change of scene can drive to the Pluak Daeng community area or into downtown Rayong, which has more options · the honest observation is that this location isn't convenient for walking to restaurants or shopping the way a city hotel is, so relying on the hotel restaurant or ordering food via an app is the route many people take · overall, food at i Boutique isn't a reason to come and eat in-house as a highlight, but the friendly-priced restaurant and the praised breakfast are a plus that fits this hotel's guests.

Service — service is another point that gets consistent praise in real reviews of i Boutique Hotel · the front-desk staff and several team members are mentioned as taking good care of guests, friendly, and very helpful, which many reviews score highly · for guests on longer stays or who come regularly for work, the staff's warmth and their ability to remember regulars' faces and names is valuable, because it makes the place feel like a home base rather than a hotel you just pass through · services that help this group include coordinating things in the area, restaurant information, and looking after parking · that said, to be fair, some voices in the reviews note that service at certain times is more "okay" than excellent every time, especially during busy periods · overall, service is still a strength and one of the reasons the review scores are solid for a hotel at this price.

What real reviews say (praise and gripes) — pulling from Trip.com, Booking.com, Agoda and Hotels.com, the picture that emerges is fairly consistent · on the praise side: rooms that are more spacious and cleaner than the price paid, comfortable beds, a quiet setting that's easy to sleep in, easy and free parking, breakfast and a restaurant that are inexpensive but tasty, good and friendly staff, and a location near the Amata estate that makes driving to work convenient · many people agree it's a "good value" hotel for coming to work or staying several nights · on the observation side: what comes up is that parts of the building and decor are starting to show their age since it opened in 2016, and some reviews say certain corners feel dim or too quiet · next is that the location is in an estate area, not a tourist district, which makes it inconvenient to walk to restaurants or shopping and means you have to drive yourself, the lack of a swimming pool for people who want a resort-style break, and in-room Wi-Fi that comes with conditions or an extra charge on certain packages · most of these gripes are things you can resolve by setting your expectations to match the hotel's concept — you come for value, quiet, and real usability, not for a holiday atmosphere or new-and-luxurious finishes.

"The room was clean and spacious, the staff were lovely and helpful, and the food in the hotel was cheap but tasty. My only gripe is that the building looks a little old, and there's nothing to stroll to around it, so you have to drive out to eat — but if you're here to work at the estate, it's great value."

Price comparison and value — the starting price for a Standard room is around THB 860/night in the normal price range, moving up to around THB 1,100-1,600+ for Deluxe and Grand Deluxe rooms depending on room type, season, and each platform's deals · for people coming to work at the estate and staying several nights or regularly, there are often special rates for weekly or monthly stays that work out even better per night, which you should ask the hotel about directly · compared with hotels and accommodation in the same class in Map Yang Phon and around the Amata City Rayong estate, i Boutique feels good value within the group of accommodation for working guests and longer stays, especially when you factor in the spacious rooms, cleanliness, the praised breakfast, and free parking · if you're planning to stay several nights to work at the estate, or you want a room with real usable space on a controlled budget, the money you spend here goes a long way · but if you're looking for a place specifically to enjoy the beaches at Pattaya or Rayong, the value drops because you have to add the cost of getting to the coast and the tourist districts, and it may be better value to stay on the beach side from the start.

What to know before you book — there are several things that help make a stay smoother · one, if you're coming to work at the estate or staying several nights, ask about weekly or monthly rates directly with the hotel (call 086-770-8888), because you often get a lower per-night price than booking nightly through a platform · two, if you need heavy internet use or online meetings, check the in-room Wi-Fi conditions clearly and keep a backup mobile SIM or pocket Wi-Fi on hand · three, this hotel doesn't have a swimming pool, so if that matters to you or your kids, consider another place with a pool · four, if you don't have your own car, plan your transport and meals in advance, because the estate location doesn't let you walk far — be ready to use a ride-hailing app and check which restaurants do delivery · five, pick a 37 sqm Deluxe room if you want a spacious space and a balcony for a longer stay, while for a single night the Standard room is enough · six, choose the free-cancellation option first if your plans aren't certain yet, and compare prices across several platforms because the deals often differ.

The verdict — from all the real reviews, i Boutique Hotel is the best fit for people coming to work or do business at the Amata City Rayong estate and the Pluak Daeng industrial area, and people who want a spacious, quiet, good-value room for a longer stay · rooms that are more spacious than the price, cleanliness, a quiet setting that's easy to sleep in, food and breakfast at friendly prices, free parking, and a location you can drive to the estate from easily make it a hard option to beat on value in this area · if you're looking for a place by the sea for a holiday break, want a swimming pool, or want a resort atmosphere and a location you can walk around, this may not be the answer, and you should consider staying on the Pattaya side or in downtown Rayong instead · but for a work trip, a longer stay, or an overnight stop while traveling on a controlled budget, with cleanliness and friendly service — i Boutique Hotel answers that need squarely, and that's why it still earns good review scores from guests who know what they came for.

honestSummary: i Boutique Hotel is the best hotel for people who want to stay near the Amata City Rayong estate on an affordable budget, with spacious, clean rooms and a quiet setting — great for estate workers, longer stays, and people driving through who need a good-value overnight stop · but you have to accept that the building has been open since 2016 so some parts are starting to show their age, there's no swimming pool, and the location is in an estate area that's most convenient to get around with your own car.
honestChecks: If you're mainly here to enjoy the beaches at Pattaya or Rayong — this place is in an estate area 40-50 km from the coast and you have to drive yourself → consider staying on the Pattaya side or in downtown Rayong instead to save time and travel cost.
If you want a swimming pool or a resort atmosphere — this hotel has no swimming pool and is a practical boutique style, not a holiday spot → choose a place with a pool and more complete facilities.

If you don't have your own car — the estate location doesn't let you walk far, and the area around the hotel isn't a restaurant or shopping district → be ready to use a ride-hailing app and plan your meals and delivery in advance.

faqTitle: Frequently asked questions — i Boutique Hotel Pluak Daeng

faq.q: Where is i Boutique Hotel · is it easy to get to?
faq.a: The hotel is at 555/33-34 Moo 6, Map Yang Phon Subdistrict, Pluak Daeng District, Rayong Province, in the area near the Amata City Rayong industrial estate · it's a few minutes' drive to the estate, around 3 km to CK Stadium, around 44-45 km to Pattaya Beach, and around 37 km from U-Tapao Airport · this location is most convenient when you have your own car, because the area around the hotel isn't a stroll-friendly district.

faq.q: Who is i Boutique Hotel for?
faq.a: It's a great fit for people coming to work or do business at the Amata City Rayong estate and the Pluak Daeng industrial area, people on longer stays, and people driving through who need a good-value overnight stop · spacious, clean rooms, a quiet setting, free parking, and friendly-priced food · if you're mainly here to enjoy the beaches at Pattaya or Rayong, accommodation on the beach side may suit you better.

faq.q: What is i Boutique Hotel's starting price · what room types are there?
faq.a: Prices start from about THB 860/night for a Standard room in the normal price range · there are Deluxe King and Deluxe Twin rooms at around 37 sqm with a balcony, and Grand Deluxe / Suite rooms for families or longer stays · if you're staying several nights or coming to work at the estate, you should call the hotel directly to ask about weekly or monthly rates (086-770-8888) — you often get a much lower per-night price.

faq.q: Does i Boutique Hotel have a swimming pool and breakfast?
faq.a: The hotel has no swimming pool, but it does have a gym, billiard room, garden, and terrace to use · there's a restaurant serving friendly-priced Thai food and a buffet breakfast that gets praise for being filling and good value · there's free parking on the hotel grounds, and free Wi-Fi in the common areas (in-room use on some packages has conditions).

faq.q: What's the building's age and atmosphere like at i Boutique?
faq.a: The building has been open since 2016, so many reviews note that some details are starting to show their age and certain corners feel dim or quiet · even so, most reviews still praise the rooms for being spacious, clean, and quiet enough to sleep well · if you put a high value on new-and-luxurious, adjust your expectations, but if you're looking at value and real usability for working at the estate, it does well at this price.

faq.q: Are there restaurants or places to eat around i Boutique Hotel?
faq.a: The location is in Map Yang Phon, which isn't a dense restaurant or shopping district · around the hotel there are local eateries and convenience stores within a short drive, but it isn't convenient for walking · many people choose to eat in the hotel's inexpensive restaurant, order delivery, or drive to the Pluak Daeng community and downtown Rayong, which have more options.
